failed_operation.stderr: error: src refspec refs/heads/main matches more than one

outcome.interpretation: The attempted push failed because a local branch was itself named refs/heads/main. After removing only that redundant ref, a normal push succeeded. This establishes the cause of this push attempt, not of other historical authorization failures.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A fully qualified local branch name makes a normal main push ambiguous
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Git branch and ref handling in the MNCS workspace
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One normal push failed with a refspec ambiguity while a local branch named refs/heads/main pointed to an older commit. Removing that pointer restored ordinary push behavior, and the older commit remained reachable through main.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Trace how fully qualified ref names become local branch names, reject duplicate refs/heads prefixes at branch creation boundaries, and preserve commits referenced by campaign evidence when cleaning stale local refs.
